001: I have a business trip to Osaka next week.
Really? How many days is it for?
Three days. From Tuesday to Thursday.
In that case, you should book the Shinkansen early.
That's true. I'll arrange it within tomorrow.
Should I book a hotel together as well?
002: For the business trip preparation, where should I start?
First, you need to get an appointment with the company you're visiting.
I've already contacted them. They said it's okay.
Then, let's decide on transportation and accommodation next.
I'm thinking of the Shinkansen and a hotel near the station.
Sounds good. I'll help you prepare the documents.
003: Could you check the documents I'm taking on the business trip?
Of course. Please show me the list.
This is the list of materials I've prepared so far.
It looks like the original contract is missing.
Also, you should bring extra business cards to be safe.
004: I've put together the schedule for the Osaka trip.
Oh, really? What did you plan?
Day one is travel and a meeting, day two is a factory tour.
What are you planning for day three?
I plan to have a debriefing in the morning and head back in the afternoon.
005: What should I wear for the business trip?
I think it depends on the company you're visiting.
This time there's a factory tour too, so I'm torn.
In that case, it's a good idea to bring a suit and safety shoes.
I see. Can I borrow a helmet over there?
I think you'll be fine if you confirm in advance.
006: I'm filling out the expense report for the trip.
Have you calculated the transportation and lodging costs yet?
I've calculated the Shinkansen and hotel.
Meal expenses will be filed as a per diem.
Is that so? This is my first time, so that helps.
Make sure you keep all your receipts.
007: What if I get an urgent call during the trip?
It'll be fine if they contact you on your cell phone.
It'd be a problem if I'm somewhere without reception.
You should also give them the hotel's phone number.
I'll do that. I'll give them both just in case.
008: Could you make copies of the materials I'll use at the destination?
How many copies do you need?
There are five people on their side, so seven copies, please.
Should we make it ten copies including spares?
That would be a big help.
Then I'll prepare them right away.
009: Is there anything I should do before the trip?
Cleaning your desk and sharing emergency contacts.
I've already handed things over to the person in charge.
Then all that's left is checking your luggage.
Right. I'll check that I haven't forgotten anything.
010: By when do I need to submit the trip report?
The guideline is within three days after you return.
Got it. I'll write it by Monday next week.
It's convenient to put photos and data together as well.
I'll do that. I'll take notes while I'm there.
Then the report should be easy to write.
